token.desc: Auth token with which to authenticate the session

changes.desc: List of changes to apply on the specified canvas. The markdown content of each change is limited to 1 MiB (1,048,576 characters).

canvas_not_found.desc: The canvas you wish to apply changes to is not available.

canvas_disabled_user_team.desc: Canvas is disabled on user's team

free_teams_cannot_edit_standalone_canvas.desc: Free teams cannot edit standalone canvases

restricted_action.desc: User does not have permission to perform this action.

canvas_editing_failed.desc: The changes to the canvas failed to be applied.

canvas_editing_locked.desc: Another edit to this canvas is currently in progress. Please retry after a short delay.

canvas_too_large.desc: The canvas is too large to apply the requested changes. Reduce the size of the canvas or the edit and try again.
